verdict.line: You lose if you let him freeze and farm stacks uncontested past level 6; you win if you force all-ins before his R timer and keep the lane pushed into him.

brief.thesis: This matchup is even on paper (49% over 153 games) but structurally about tempo: Nasus is a scaling threat whose Q (Siphoning Strike, 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown) only gets dangerous once he's stacked it for tens of minutes, while you have the stronger all-in from level 3 onward via E (Death's Grasp) into Q (Obliterate). Your job is to deny stacks and win early skirmishes before his Q damage compounds.

theirWindow.when: R (Fury of the Sands) is up, 120s cd
theirWindow.what: While his ultimate is active he gains bonus Health, attack range, and drains your max Health into bonus damage for its duration — do not extend trades or stand still near him once he pops it, disengage and let the storm expire.

yourWindow.when: His W (Wither) and R are both down
yourWindow.what: Without Wither's Movement/Attack Speed slow or his R's stat drain, Nasus has no way to stick to you or burst you — this is when you walk E into Q and trade freely.

start.why: 48.1% win rate over 154 games and the dominant 80.2% pick — the extra sustain and mana let you contest trades and spam Q (Obliterate) on his minions to deny his Q (Siphoning Strike) last-hits.

boots.why: 50.5% win rate over 103 games and 57.2% pick — the flat physical damage reduction directly undercuts his auto-attack and stacked Q damage, which is all he has.

core.why: First item in all three measured build paths; the slow from your Q/E lets you land both hits of Obliterate and keep him inside Death's Grasp range.
Appears in every top build path; sustained magic damage punishes him for standing in melee range to farm or trade.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in 50% of games at 33.7% pick (and 48.8% at 21.9% pick with the Sorcery variant); the stacking adaptive damage and healing reward exactly the kind of extended E-into-Q trades you want to force before his stacks matter.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the strongest measured combo here (54.5% win rate, 11.3% pick) — Teleport lets you reset after all-in windows and keep pushed waves from being wasted, which matters more than kill pressure in a lane that's even on paper.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike's bonus damage compounds every time he kills a minion with it — the longer the lane goes uncontested, the worse this matchup gets for you regardless of the even overall win rate.

playing.title: All-in between levels 3 and 5
playing.detail: Walk E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Q (Obliterate) — at this stage his Q stacks are low and he has no Wither slow yet, so this is your best damage window in the whole lane.

playing.title: Respect the R timer after level 6
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands is on a 120s cooldown — once he uses it, you have a full two minutes where he has no stat-drain all-in, which is your signal to re-engage freely.

playing.title: Hold W until the trade starts
playing.detail: Indestructible's shield (12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) is strongest when popped mid-trade rather than pre-emptively, since it banks the damage you're about to take or deal.

playing.title: Don't facetank Wither
playing.detail: Wither decelerates your Movement and Attack Speed over time on a 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown — if he lands it, disengage rather than fighting through the slow stacking up.

playing.title: Push waves, don't freeze
playing.detail: A frozen lane lets him safely farm Q stacks under tower; keep the wave pushed toward him so he's forced to either give up CS or take E-Q trades on cooldown.

playing.title: Save R for priority, not just kill threat
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes him from the fight and steals his stats — use it to swing a 2v2 nearby or to deny his R timing rather than only as a panic button.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade patterns is our own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Use [P] to gain the upper hand in prolonged fights and gain lane control. Purchase Bramble Vest and other items that increase armor.
